title: 동물원 및 수족관의 관리에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Marine Ecology Division ), 051-773-5315, 5317
rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Marine Ecology Division ), 051-773-5315, 5317

rows.text_en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment ( Biodiversity Division ), 044-201-7240

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Method of Fact-Finding Survey, etc.) ① The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisherieshereinafter referred to as the “fact-finding survey” ) every five years pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums ( hereinafter referred to as the “Act”). However, if necessary, the fact-finding survey may be conducted at any time. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Method of Fact-Finding Survey, etc.) ① The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall conduct a fact-finding survey (hereinafter referred to as the “fact-finding survey”) every five years pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”). However, if necessary, the fact-finding survey may be conducted at any time. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② The fact-finding survey shall be conducted by on-site inspection or written survey; however, if necessary for an efficient survey, it may be conducted by electronic means such as information and communication networks or e-mail.
rows.text_en: ② The fact-finding survey shall be conducted by on-site inspection or written survey; however, if necessary for an efficient survey, it may be conducted by electronic means such as information and communication networks or e-mail.

rows.source_ko: ③ When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intend to conduct a survey on the status of affairs, they shall notify the subjects of the survey in writing in advance of the survey plan, which includes the timing, methods, and content of the survey. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: ③ When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries intend to conduct a survey on the status of affairs, they shall notify the subjects of the survey in writing in advance of the survey plan, which includes the timing, methods, and content of the survey. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may, if necessary, conduct a fact-finding survey with the support of zoo inspectors or aquarium inspectors appointed pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act , or jointly with institutions or organizations possessing expertise related to zoos and aquariums. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: ④ The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may, if necessary, conduct a fact-finding survey with the support of zoo inspectors or aquarium inspectors appointed pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1 of the Act , or jointly with institutions or organizations possessing expertise related to zoos and aquariums. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall notify the Mayors of Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Governors of Provinces, and Governors of Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governors”) of the results of the fact-finding survey. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall notify the Mayors of Special Cities, Metropolitan Cities, Special Self-Governing Cities, Governors of Provinces, and Governors of Special Self-Governing Provinces (hereinafter referred to as “City/Provincial Governors”) of the results of the fact-finding survey. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Method of Evaluation for Implementation, etc. of the Comprehensive Plan) In cases where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries conduct an evaluation of the implementation, etc. of the Comprehensive Plan for the Management of Zoos and Aquariums (hereinafter referred to as the “Comprehensive Plan”) pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act, they may consult in advance with the Zoo and Aquarium Animal Management Committee pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act regarding the plan and method of said evaluation. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Method of Evaluation for Implementation, etc. of the Comprehensive Plan) In cases where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries conduct an evaluation of the implementation, etc. of the Comprehensive Plan for the Management of Zoos and Aquariums (hereinafter referred to as the “Comprehensive Plan”) pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act, they may consult in advance with the Zoo and Aquarium Animal Management Committee pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act regarding the plan and method of said evaluation. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Publication of Results of Fact-Finding Surveys and Evaluations) In cases where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries publish the results of fact-finding surveys and evaluations regarding the implementation, etc. of comprehensive plans pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act , they shall publish the results on the internet websites of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, including the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Publication of Results of Fact-Finding Surveys and Evaluations) In cases where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries publish the results of fact-finding surveys and evaluations regarding the implementation, etc. of comprehensive plans pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 3 of the Act , they shall publish the results on the internet websites of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, including the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. Matters concerning the current status of operation of zoo and aquarium exhibition facilities
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the current status of operation of zoo and aquarium exhibition facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. Matters concerning the welfare status of animals in captivity, such as habitat environment
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the welfare status of animals in captivity, such as habitat environment

rows.source_ko: 3. Matters concerning the status of safety and disease management in zoos and aquariums
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the status of safety and disease management in zoos and aquariums

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Animals Requiring Additional Specialized Personnel) In Annex 1, Item 1, Subparagraph (a), 2)a)(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “animals prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the animals listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Animals Requiring Additional Specialized Personnel) In Annex 1, Item 1, Subparagraph (a), 2)a)(1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”), the term “animals prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the animals listed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. All species of the Elephant, Rhinoceros, Hippopotamus, and Ursidae families
rows.text_en: 1. All species of the Elephant, Rhinoceros, Hippopotamus, and Ursidae families

rows.source_ko: 2. Lions, tigers, pumas, leopards, snow leopards, jaguars, lynxes, cheetahs, coyotes, jackals, wolves, hyenas, African wild dogs, and other animals of similar origin among the order Carnivora.
rows.text_en: 2. Lions, tigers, pumas, leopards, snow leopards, jaguars, lynxes, cheetahs, coyotes, jackals, wolves, hyenas, African wild dogs, and other animals of similar origin among the order Carnivora.

rows.source_ko: 3. Among primates, gorillas, chimpanzees, orangutans, Philippine macaques, baboons, etc.
rows.text_en: 3. Among primates, gorillas, chimpanzees, orangutans, Philippine macaques, baboons, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 우제목 중 물소, 들소, 기린, 낙타 및 그 밖에 이에 준하는 동물
rows.text_en: 4. Among the order Artiodactyla, water buffalo, bison, giraffe, camel, and other animals of a similar nature

rows.source_ko: 5. 뱀목 중 노랑아나콘다, 붉은꼬리보아, 듀메릴보아, 그물무늬비단왕뱀, 자수정비단왕뱀, 버마비단왕뱀, 아프리카비단왕뱀, 살모사류, 코브라류, 바다뱀류, 아메리카독도마뱀, 멕시코독도마뱀 및 그 밖에 이에 준하는 동물
rows.text_en: 5. Among the order Serpentes, the yellow anaconda, red-tailed boa, Dumérill's boa, reticulated python, amethyst python, Burmese python, African python, vipers, cobras, sea snakes, American venomous lizard, Mexican venomous lizard, and other animals equivalent thereto

rows.source_ko: 6. 악어목 전종
rows.text_en: 6. All species of the order Crocodilia

rows.source_ko: 7. 왕도마뱀과 중 코모도왕도마뱀, 크로커다일왕도마뱀 및 그 밖에 이에 준하는 동물
rows.text_en: 7. Among the monitor lizard family, the Komodo dragon, the crocodile monitor lizard, and other animals equivalent thereto

rows.source_ko: 제6조(허가 및 변경허가의 신청 등) ① 영 제9조제3항에 따라 동물원 또는 수족관의 허가 또는 변경허가를 신청하려는 자는 별지 제1호서식의 허가ㆍ변경허가 신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 유역환경청장ㆍ지방환경청장, 지방해양수산청장 또는 시ㆍ도지사(이하 “허가권자”라 한다)에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Application for Permission and Amendment Permission, etc.) ① A person who intends to apply for a permit or an amendment permit for a zoo or aquarium pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit the application for a permit or amendment permit in the form of Annex No. 1, along with the documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs, to the head of the basin environment office, the head of the regional environment office, the head of the regional maritime affairs and fisheries office, or the mayor/governor of a city/province (hereinafter referred to as the “permit authority”).

rows.source_ko: 1. 동물원 또는 수족관의 허가 신청의 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In the case of an application for a license for a zoo or aquarium

rows.source_ko: 가. 시설의 명세서, 내부ㆍ외부 사진 및 평면도
rows.text_en: a. Specifications of the facility, interior and exterior photographs, and floor plan

rows.source_ko: 나. 전문인력의 자격을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: B. Documents proving the qualifications of professional personnel

rows.source_ko: 다. 보유동물 질병관리계획
rows.text_en: C. Disease Management Plan for Owned Animals

rows.source_ko: 라. 동물원 또는 수족관 안전관리계획
rows.text_en: D. Safety management plan for zoos or aquariums

rows.source_ko: 마. 동물원의 휴ㆍ폐원 또는 수족관의 휴ㆍ폐관 시 보유동물 관리계획
rows.text_en: E. Management plan for animals in the event of temporary or permanent closure of a zoo or aquarium

rows.source_ko: 바. 보유동물을 활용한 교육 계획 및 보유동물 복지증진 계획
rows.text_en: F. Education plan utilizing animals and plan for promoting animal welfare

rows.source_ko: 2. 동물원 또는 수족관의 변경허가 신청의 경우
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of an application for a permit to change a zoo or aquarium

rows.source_ko: 가. 동물원 또는 수족관 허가증 원본
rows.text_en: a. Original zoo or aquarium permit

rows.source_ko: 나. 허가사항의 변경을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: B. Documents proving the change of permitted matters

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제8조제3항에 따른 허가증은 별지 제2호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The permit pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto .

rows.source_ko: 제7조(현장조사 결과보고서) 영 제10조제3항에 따른 현장조사 결과보고서는 별지 제3호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Field Investigation Result Report) The field investigation result report pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(행정처분의 세부기준) 법 제10조제3항에 따른 행정처분의 세부기준은 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Detailed Standards for Administrative Dispositions) The detailed standards for administrative dispositions pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 3 of the Act are as set forth in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(동물원 및 수족관의 의무 개방 일수) ① 법 제13조제1항에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 일수”란 연간 90일을 말한다. 이 경우 1일 개방시간은 4시간 이상이어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Mandatory Opening Days for Zoos and Aquariums) ① In Article 13, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “number of days prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to 90 days per year. In this case, the daily opening time must be at least 4 hours. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ② 「감염병의 예방 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제2조제11호에 따른 인수공통감염병(이하 “인수공통감염병”이라 한다) 발생 등 예상하지 못한 사유가 발생하여 개방하지 않는 일수는 제1항에 따른 의무 개방 일수에 포함한다.
rows.text_en: ② The number of days for which a facility is not opened due to unforeseen circumstances, such as the occurrence of a zoonotic disease pursuant to Article 2, Item 11 of the Infectious Disease Control and Prevention Act (hereinafter referred to as “zoonotic disease”), shall be included in the mandatory opening days pursuant to Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 제10조(휴원ㆍ휴관 신고 방법 및 절차) ① 동물원 또는 수족관을 운영하는 자는 법 제13조제2항에 따라 해당 동물원 또는 수족관의 휴원 또는 휴관을 신고하려는 경우에는 별지 제4호서식의 휴원ㆍ휴관 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Method and Procedure for Reporting Suspension of Operation or Closure) ① A person operating a zoo or aquarium who intends to report the suspension of operation or closure of the said zoo or aquarium pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit a report on suspension of operation or closure in the form of Annex No. 4 to the licensing authority, attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 휴원ㆍ휴관 사유서
rows.text_en: 1. Statement of Reason for Temporary Closure

rows.source_ko: 2. 휴원ㆍ휴관 기간 동안의 보유동물 관리계획
rows.text_en: 2. Management Plan for Animals in House During Closure Period

rows.source_ko: 3. 향후 개방계획
rows.text_en: 3. Future Opening Plans

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 휴원ㆍ휴관 신고서를 제출받은 허가권자는 동물원 또는 수족관의 휴원 또는 휴관 신고를 한 자가 제1항제2호에 따른 휴원ㆍ휴관 기간 동안의 보유동물 관리계획을 적정하게 이행하고 있는지를 확인ㆍ점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The licensing authority that receives the report of temporary closure or suspension of operation pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify and inspect whether the person who reported the temporary closure or suspension of operation of the zoo or aquarium is properly implementing the animal management plan during the temporary closure or suspension period pursuant to Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2.

rows.source_ko: 제11조(폐원ㆍ폐관 시의 조치사항) 법 제13조제3항에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 조치”란 보유동물의 이관 조치 등 법 제8조제1항제4호에 따른 휴ㆍ폐원 시 보유동물 관리계획에 따른 조치를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Measures to be Taken Upon Closure or Discontinuation) In Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the term “measures prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to measures, such as the transfer of animals in possession, in accordance with the animal management plan for temporary suspension or closure pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Act . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(폐원ㆍ폐관 신고의 방법 및 절차) ① 동물원 또는 수족관을 운영하는 자는 법 제13조제3항에 따라 해당 동물원 또는 수족관의 폐원 또는 폐관을 신고하려는 경우에는 폐원일 또는 폐관일 30일 전까지 별지 제5호서식의 폐원ㆍ폐관 신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Method and Procedure for Reporting Closure of Zoo or Aquarium) ① A person operating a zoo or aquarium who intends to report the closure of the zoo or aquarium pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall submit a report on closure of zoo or aquarium in the form of Annex No. 5, attached with the documents of each of the following subparagraphs, to the licensing authority no later than 30 days prior to the date of closure.

rows.source_ko: 1. 동물원 또는 수족관 허가증 원본
rows.text_en: 1. Original zoo or aquarium permit

rows.source_ko: 2. 제11조에 따른 조치를 적정하게 이행하였음을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving that the measures under Article 11 have been properly implemented

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 폐원ㆍ폐관 신고서를 제출받은 허가권자는 동물원 또는 수족관의 폐원 또는 폐관 신고를 한 자가 제11조에 따른 조치를 적정하게 이행하였는지를 확인ㆍ점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The licensing authority that receives the report of closure or closure pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify and inspect whether the person who reported the closure or closure of the zoo or aquarium has properly implemented the measures pursuant to Article 11 .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(동물종 조사의 내용 및 방법) ① 법 제14조제1항에 따른 동물종 조사(이하 “동물종 조사”라 한다)의 대상은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Contents and Methods of Animal Species Survey) ① The subjects of the animal species survey pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “animal species survey”) are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제2조제2호에 따른 멸종위기 야생생물
rows.text_en: 1. Endangered wildlife pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 2 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제2조제3호에 따른 국제적 멸종위기종
rows.text_en: 2. Internationally endangered species pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「해양생태계의 보전 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제2조제11호에 따른 해양보호생물
rows.text_en: 3. Marine protected species pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 11 of the Act on the Conservation and Management of Marine Ecosystems

rows.source_ko: ② 동물종 조사에는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The animal species survey shall include the following matters. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 동물종 개체 현황 및 번식을 위한 관리 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Status of Animal Species Individuals and Management for Breeding

rows.source_ko: 2. 사육시설 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Current Status of Rearing Facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 온도, 습도, 채광, 조도 등 동물종의 서식환경
rows.text_en: 3. Habitat of animal species, such as temperature, humidity, lighting, and illuminance

rows.source_ko: 4. 동물종의 건강ㆍ영양관리 현황 및 복지 상태
rows.text_en: 4. Status of Health and Nutrition Management and Welfare of Animal Species

rows.source_ko: 5. 동물원ㆍ수족관 내 동물종, 직원 및 공중을 위한 안전시설 현황
rows.text_en: 5. Status of Safety Facilities for Animal Species, Staff, and the Public in Zoos and Aquariums

rows.source_ko: 6. 인수공통감염병의 예방 및 공중보건 체계
rows.text_en: 6. Prevention of Zoonotic Diseases and Public Health System

rows.source_ko: 7. 그 밖에 해당 동물종의 보호와 복지를 위하여 조사할 필요가 있다고 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관이 인정하는 사항
rows.text_en: 7. Other matters deemed necessary to investigate for the protection and welfare of the relevant animal species by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries

rows.source_ko: ③ 동물종 조사의 방법에 관하여는 제2조제2항부터 제5항까지의 규정을 준용한다. 이 경우 “기후에너지환경부장관 및 해양수산부장관”은 “유역환경청장ㆍ지방환경청장 및 지방해양수산청장”으로, “실태조사”는 “동물종 조사”로 본다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The provisions of Paragraphs 2 through 5 of Article 2 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the methods of animal species surveys . In this case, “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and Minister of Oceans and Fisheries” shall be deemed to be “Heads of Basin Environmental Offices, Regional Environmental Offices, and Regional Maritime and Fisheries Offices,” and “status survey” shall be deemed to be “animal species survey.” <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제14조(금지행위의 예외) 법 제15조제1항제3호나목에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 경우”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Exceptions to Prohibited Acts) In Article 15, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 , Item (b) of the Act , the phrase “cases prescribed by a joint ministerial decree of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to any of the following cases: <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 영 제9조제2항에 따른 보유동물을 활용한 교육 계획에 따라 사회공헌활동의 목적으로 대가 없이 보유동물을 이동하여 전시하는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where animals are transported and exhibited without compensation for the purpose of social contribution activities in accordance with an educational plan utilizing animals pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 학술 연구 또는 교육의 목적으로 보유동물을 다음 각 목에 해당하는 기관으로 이동하여 전시하는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where animals are transferred to and exhibited at institutions falling under any of the following subparagraphs for the purpose of academic research or education

rows.source_ko: 가. 「과학관의 설립ㆍ운영 및 육성에 관한 법률」에 따른 과학관
rows.text_en: a. Science museums pursuant to the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Science Museums

rows.source_ko: 나. 「생물자원관의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 생물자원관
rows.text_en: B. Biological resource center pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resource Centers

rows.source_ko: 다. 「수목원ㆍ정원의 조성 및 진흥에 관한 법률」 제5조에 따른 국공립수목원
rows.text_en: C. National and public arboretums pursuant to Article 5 of the Act on the Establishment and Promotion of Arboretums and Gardens

rows.source_ko: 라. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제7조제1항에 따라 지정된 서식지외보전기관
rows.text_en: D. Ex-situ conservation institutions designated pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 마. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제8조의4에 따른 유기ㆍ방치 야생동물 보호시설
rows.text_en: E. Protection facilities for abandoned or neglected wild animals pursuant to Article 8-4 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 바. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제34조의4제2항에 따른 야생동물의 질병연구 및 구조ㆍ치료시설
rows.text_en: f. Wildlife disease research and rescue/treatment facilities pursuant to Article 34-4, Paragraph 2 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 사. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제35조제1항에 따라 등록된 생물자원 보전시설
rows.text_en: G. Biological resource conservation facilities registered pursuant to Article 35, Paragraph 1 of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 아. 「국립해양생물자원관의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 국립해양생물자원관
rows.text_en: A. The National Marine Biological Resources Center pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biological Resources Center

rows.source_ko: 자. 「해양생태계의 보전 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항에 따라 지정된 서식지외보전기관
rows.text_en: J. Ex-situ conservation institutions designated pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Conservation and Management of Marine Ecosystems

rows.source_ko: 차. 「해양생태계의 보전 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제18조에 따른 해양동물전문구조ㆍ치료기관
rows.text_en: D. Specialized marine animal rescue and treatment institutions pursuant to Article 18 of the Act on the Conservation and Management of Marine Ecosystems

rows.source_ko: 제15조(관람 목적의 보유 금지 종) 법 제15조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 종”이란 고래목에 속하는 동물을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Species Prohibited from Possession for Viewing Purposes) In Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act , “species prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to animals belonging to the order Cetacea. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(전염성이 높은 야생동물 질병) 법 제17조제2항제3호에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 전염성이 높은 질병”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 질병을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Highly Infectious Wildlife Diseases) In Article 17, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 3 of the Act , the term “highly infectious diseases prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to any of the diseases falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「야생생물 보호 및 관리에 관한 법률」 제2조제8호의2에 따른 야생동물 검역대상질병
rows.text_en: 1. Wildlife quarantine diseases pursuant to Article 2 , Subparagraph 8-2 ​​of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 그 밖에 국립야생동물질병관리원장 또는 국립수산물품질관리원장이 고시하는 질병
rows.text_en: 2. Other diseases designated by the Director of the National Wildlife Disease Control Center or the Director of the National Fisheries Quality Management Service

rows.source_ko: 제17조(생태계교란 방지를 위한 조치) 법 제18조제2항에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 조치”란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 조치를 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Measures for the Prevention of Ecosystem Disturbance) In Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Act , the term “measures prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to any of the measures falling under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 보유동물의 포획 조치
rows.text_en: 1. Measures to capture animals in custody

rows.source_ko: 2. 보유동물의 탈출 방지 및 이동 제한을 위한 시설 설치
rows.text_en: 2. Installation of facilities to prevent escape and restrict the movement of animals

rows.source_ko: 3. 보유동물의 격리 조치
rows.text_en: 3. Isolation measures for animals in custody

rows.source_ko: 제18조(교육기관) ① 법 제19조제1항에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 교육기관”이란 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기관(이하 “교육기관”이라 한다)을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Educational Institutions) ① In Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the term “educational institutions prescribed by the joint decree of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to institutions classified according to each of the following subparagraphs (hereinafter referred to as “educational institutions”). <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 동물원 대상 교육기관: 다음 각 목의 기관
rows.text_en: 1. Educational institutions for zoos: The following institutions

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제8조제1항에 따라 허가받은 동물원 중 기후에너지환경부장관이 정하는 동물원
rows.text_en: a. Zoos designated by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment among those licensed pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「국립생태원의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 국립생태원
rows.text_en: B. The National Institute of Ecology pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology

rows.source_ko: 다. 「기후에너지환경부 및 기상청 소관 비영리법인의 설립과 감독에 관한 규칙」에 따라 야생동물의 보전ㆍ연구ㆍ사육관리 및 복지증진을 목적으로 설립된 비영리법인 중 기후에너지환경부장관이 정하는 기관
rows.text_en: C. Among non-profit corporations established for the purpose of conservation, research, breeding management, and welfare promotion of wild animals pursuant to the "Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Non-profit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Korea Meteorological Administration, " institutions designated by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment

rows.source_ko: 2. 수족관 대상 교육기관: 다음 각 목의 기관
rows.text_en: 2. Educational institutions for aquariums: The following institutions

rows.source_ko: 가. 법 제8조제1항에 따라 허가받은 수족관 중 해양수산부장관이 정하는 수족관
rows.text_en: a. Aquariums designated by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries among those licensed pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 나. 「해양환경관리법」 제96조에 따른 해양환경공단
rows.text_en: B. Korea Marine Environment Corporation pursuant to Article 96 of the Marine Environment Management Act

rows.source_ko: 다. 「국립해양생물자원관의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 국립해양생물자원관
rows.text_en: C. National Marine Biological Resources Center pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biological Resources Center

rows.source_ko: 라. 「해양수산부장관 및 그 소속 청장 소관 비영리법인의 설립 및 감독에 관한 규칙」에 따라 해양생물 및 담수동물의 보전ㆍ연구ㆍ사육관리 및 복지증진을 목적으로 설립된 비영리법인 중 해양수산부장관이 정하는 기관
rows.text_en: D. Among non-profit corporations established for the purpose of conservation, research, breeding management, and welfare promotion of marine organisms and freshwater animals pursuant to the "Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Non-profit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and the Heads of Subordinate Agencies," institutions designated by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries.

rows.source_ko: ② 교육기관의 장은 교육을 이수한 사람에게 별지 제6호서식의 교육이수증을 발급해야 하며, 해당 연도의 동물원 및 수족관별 교육실적을 다음 연도의 2월 말일까지 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관에게 보고해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of an educational institution shall issue a Certificate of Completion of Education in the form of Annex 6 to persons who have completed the education , and shall report the educational performance results for each zoo and aquarium for the relevant year to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries by the end of February of the following year. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 기후에너지환경부장관 및 해양수산부장관은 제2항에 따라 제출받은 동물원ㆍ수족관별 교육실적을 허가권자에게 알려야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall notify the licensing authority of the educational performance results for each zoo and aquarium submitted pursuant to Paragraph 2. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ④ 교육기관의 장은 다음 연도의 교육계획을 수립하여 매년 12월 31일까지 기후에너지환경부장관 및 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ The head of an educational institution shall formulate an education plan for the following year and submit it to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries by December 31 of each year. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 교육의 실시에 필요한 사항은 기후에너지환경부장관 및 해양수산부장관이 정한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 through 4, matters necessary for the implementation of education shall be determined by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries . <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제19조(교육의 내용 및 시간) 법 제19조제1항에 따른 교육대상자는 매년 1회 이상 교육기관에서 실시하는 교육을 받아야 하며, 교육대상자별 교육 내용 및 시간은 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Content and Time of Education) Persons subject to education pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall receive education conducted by an educational institution at least once a year, and the content and time of education for each subject shall be as set forth in Attached Table 2 .

rows.source_ko: 제20조(운영ㆍ관리 기록 및 보존) 법 제20조제4호에서 “기후에너지환경부와 해양수산부의 공동부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Operation, Management, Records, and Preservation) In Subparagraph 4 of Article 20 of the Act , the term “matters prescribed by the Joint Ministerial Ordinance of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries” refers to the matters in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 사육시설의 관리 및 변경에 관한 기록
rows.text_en: 1. Records regarding the management and alteration of breeding facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 수의사, 수산질병관리사 및 사육사 보유 현황 기록
rows.text_en: 2. Records of current staffing levels for veterinarians, aquatic animal disease control specialists, and animal keepers

rows.source_ko: 3. 보유동물의 질병 치료에 관한 기록
rows.text_en: 3. Records regarding the treatment of diseases in retained animals

rows.source_ko: 4. 동물원 또는 수족관 안전사고에 관한 기록
rows.text_en: 4. Records regarding safety accidents at zoos or aquariums

rows.source_ko: 제21조(동물원ㆍ수족관의 검사 시기 및 방법 등) ① 허가권자는 법 제22조제1항에 따라 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 검사를 실시해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Timing and Method of Inspection of Zoos and Aquariums, etc.) ① The licensing authorityshall conduct inspections in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 22, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 1. 정기검사: 허가 후 5년마다 1회
rows.text_en: 1. Periodic Inspection: Once every 5 years after approval

rows.source_ko: 2. 수시검사: 허가권자가 해당 동물원 또는 수족관의 시설ㆍ장비 등의 실태 및 보유동물 관리 실태, 근무자의 근무 현황을 확인할 필요가 있다고 인정하는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Unscheduled Inspection: When the licensing authority deems it necessary to verify the actual condition of facilities and equipment, the management of animals held, and the work status of employees at the relevant zoo or aquarium.

rows.source_ko: ② 허가권자는 제1항제1호에 따른 정기검사를 하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 사항을 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the licensing authority conducts a periodic inspection pursuant to Paragraph 1, Item 1, it shall verify the matters in each of the following items.

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제8조제1항에 따른 허가요건 준수 여부
rows.text_en: 1. Compliance with the permit requirements pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제13조제2항에 따른 휴원 시 관리계획 준수 여부
rows.text_en: 2. Compliance with the management plan during temporary closure pursuant to Article 13 , Paragraph 2 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제15조에 따른 금지행위 위반 여부
rows.text_en: 3. Whether there was a violation of prohibited acts under Article 15 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제16조부터 제18조까지의 사항 준수 여부
rows.text_en: 4. Compliance with the matters under Articles 16 through 18 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 교육대상자의 법 제19조에 따른 교육 이수 여부
rows.text_en: 5. Whether the person subject to education has completed the education pursuant to Article 19 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ③ 허가권자는 제1항에 따른 검사를 하려는 경우에는 검사 일시ㆍ대상 및 내용이 포함된 검사계획을 미리 동물원 또는 수족관을 운영하는 자에게 서면으로 통지해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the licensing authority intends to conduct an inspection pursuant to Paragraph 1, it must notify the person operating the zoo or aquarium in writing of an inspection plan that includes the date, time, subject, and content of the inspection.

rows.source_ko: ④ 허가권자는 제1항에 따른 검사가 완료되었을 때에는 그 결과를 검사가 완료된 날부터 30일 이내에 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ When the inspection under Paragraph 1 is completed, the licensing authority shall submit the results to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries within 30 days from the date the inspection is completed. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제22조(거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관의 지정 및 운영) ① 법 제24조제2항에 따라 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관으로 지정받으려는 자는 별지 제7호서식의 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 자료를 첨부하여 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Designation and Operation of Hub Zoos and Hub Aquariums) ①Any person who intends to be designated as a hub zoo or hub aquarium pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit an application for designation as a hub zoo or hub aquarium in the form of Annex 7 to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, attaching the materials specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 시설의 명세서, 내부ㆍ외부 사진 및 평면도
rows.text_en: 1. Specifications of the facility, interior and exterior photographs, and floor plan

rows.source_ko: 2. 인력 및 장비 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of Manpower and Equipment

rows.source_ko: 3. 보유동물 명세서
rows.text_en: 3. List of animals owned

rows.source_ko: 4. 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관의 지정요건을 갖추었음을 증명하는 자료
rows.text_en: 4. Materials proving that the designation requirements for a hub zoo or hub aquarium have been met

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 지정신청서를 제출받은 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관은 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관의 지정 여부를 결정하여 별지 제8호서식의 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관 지정서를 발급해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries who receives an application for designation pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall determine whether to designate a hub zoo or hub aquarium and issue a certificate of designation for a hub zoo or hub aquarium in the form of Annex 8. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관의 지정기간은 5년 이내로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The designation period for base zoos and base aquariums shall be within 5 years.

rows.source_ko: ④ 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관으로 지정받은 자는 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관 운영지침을 수립하여 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관의 승인을 받아야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ A person designated as a hub zoo or hub aquarium shall establish operational guidelines for the hub zoo or hub aquarium and obtain approval from the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 거점동물원ㆍ거점수족관으로 지정받은 자는 해당 연도의 운영계획과 전년도 운영 결과를 매년 1월 31일까지 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Any person designated as a hub zoo or hub aquarium shall submit the operation plan for the relevant year and the operation results of the previous year to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries by January 31 of each year. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제23조(기부금품의 접수절차 등) ① 국가 또는 지방자치단체 및 그 소속 기관에서 설립한 동물원ㆍ수족관과 국가 또는 지방자치단체에서 출자ㆍ출연하여 설립된 동물원ㆍ수족관(이하 이 조에서 “공공 동물원ㆍ수족관”이라 한다)은 법 제26조제1항에 따라 자발적으로 기탁되는 금품(이하 이 조에서 “기부금품”이라 한다)을 접수한 경우에는 기부자에게 영수증을 발급해야 한다. 다만, 익명으로 기부하거나 기부자를 알 수 없는 경우에는 영수증을 발급하지 않을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Procedures for Receiving Donations, etc.) ① Zoos and aquariums established by the State or local governments and their affiliated agencies, and zoos and aquariums established through investment or contribution by the State or local governments (hereinafter referred to as “public zoos and aquariums” in this Article) shall issue a receipt to the donor when receiving money or goods voluntarily donated pursuant to Article 26, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “donations” in this Article). However, a receipt may not be issued in cases where the donation is made anonymously or the donor cannot be identified.

rows.source_ko: ② 공공 동물원ㆍ수족관은 제1항에 따른 기부자가 기부금품의 용도를 지정한 경우에는 그 용도로만 사용해야 한다. 다만, 기부금품을 기부자가 지정한 용도로 사용하기 어려운 특별한 사유가 있는 경우에는 기후에너지환경부장관 또는 해양수산부장관과 협의를 거쳐 기부자의 동의를 받아 다른 용도로 사용할 수 있다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② Public zoos and aquariums shall use donated goods and items exclusively for the designated purpose specified by the donor pursuant to Paragraph 1. However, if there are special circumstances that make it difficult to use the donated goods and items for the purpose designated by the donor, they may be used for other purposes with the donor's consent following consultation with the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment or the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: ③ 공공 동물원ㆍ수족관은 기부금품의 접수 현황 및 사용실적 등에 대한 장부를 갖추어 두고, 기부자가 열람할 수 있도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Public zoos and aquariums must maintain ledgers regarding the status of donation receipts and usage records, and make them available for donors to inspect.

rows.source_ko: 제24조(규제의 재검토) 기후에너지환경부장관과 해양수산부장관은 제19조 및 별표 2에 따른 교육대상자별 교육 내용 및 시간에 대하여 2024년 1월 1일을 기준으로 3년마다(매 3년이 되는 해의 1월 1일 전까지를 말한다) 그 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를 해야 한다. <개정 2025. 10. 1.>
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall review the validity of the educational content and hours for each subject of education pursuant to Article 19 and Annex 2 every three years, starting from January 1, 2024 (meaning by January 1 of every third year), and take measures such as improvements. <Amended Oct. 1, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <환경부령 제1066호, 해양수산부령 제640호, 2023. 12. 14.>
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Environment Decree No. 1066, Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 640, Dec. 14, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2023년 12월 14일부터 시행한다. 다만, 제19조의 개정규정은 2024년 1월 1일부터 시행하고, 제16조제1호의 개정규정은 2024년 5월 19일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on December 14, 2023. However, the amended provisions of Article 19 shall enter into force on January 1, 2024, and the amended provisions of Article 16, subparagraph 1 shall enter into force on May 19, 2024.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(동물원 및 수족관의 의무 개방 일수에 관한 특례) 이 규칙 시행 당시 운영하고 있는 동물원 또는 수족관에 관하여 의무 개방 일수를 적용할 때에는 제9조제1항의 개정규정에도 불구하고 2023년 12월 31일까지는 그 의무 개방 일수를 30일로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special Provisions on Mandatory Opening Days for Zoos and Aquariums)  Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 1, when applying the mandatory opening days to zoos or aquariums in operation at the time of enforcement of this Rule, the mandatory opening days shall be 30 days until December 31, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <기후에너지환경부령 제1호, 2025. 10. 1.> (기후에너지환경부와 그 소속기관 직제 시행규칙)
rows.text_en: ADDENDA <Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment Decree No. 1, Oct. 1, 2025> (Enforcement Rule on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and its Affiliated Agencies)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 부칙 제6조에 따라 개정되는 부령 중 이 규칙 시행 전에 공포되었으나 시행일이 도래하지 아니한 부령을 개정한 부분은 각각 해당 부령의 시행일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. However, among the Ministerial Ordinances amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the parts amending Ministerial Ordinances that were promulgated prior to the enforcement of this Rule but whose effective date has not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Ordinances.

rows.text_en: Articles 2  through 5 omitted

rows.text_en: Article 6 (Amendment of Other Laws)  ① through ⑰ Omitted

rows.text_en: 18. The Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums are partially amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제2조제1항 본문, 같은 조 제3항부터 제5항까지, 제3조, 제4조 각 호 외의 부분, 제13조제2항제7호, 같은 조 제3항 후단, 제18조제1항제1호가목ㆍ다목, 같은 조 제2항부터 제5항까지, 제21조제4항, 제22조제1항 각 호 외의 부분, 같은 조 제2항ㆍ제4항ㆍ제5항, 제23조제2항 단서 및 제24조 중 “환경부장관”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the main text of Article 2, Paragraph 1; Paragraphs 3 through 5 of the same article; Article 3; the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 4; Article 13, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 7; the latter part of Paragraph 3 of the same article; Article 18, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1(a) and 1(c); Paragraphs 2 through 5 of the same article; Article 21, Paragraph 4; the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 22, Paragraph 1; Paragraphs 2, 4, and 5 of the same article; the proviso to Article 23, Paragraph 2; and Article 24, “Minister of Environment” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “환경부 및”을 “기후에너지환경부 및”으로 하고, 제5조 각 호 외의 부분, 제9조제1항 전단, 제11조, 제14조 각 호 외의 부분, 제15조, 제16조 각 호 외의 부분, 제17조 각 호 외의 부분, 제18조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 및 제20조 각 호 외의 부분 중 “환경부”를 “기후에너지환경부”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 4, “Ministry of Environment and” shall be changed to “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and”, and in the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 5, the first part of Paragraph 1 of Article 9, Article 11, the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 14, Article 15, the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 16, the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 17, the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 18 Paragraph 1, and the part other than the numbered clauses of Article 20, “Ministry of Environment” shall be changed to “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”.

rows.source_ko: 제18조제1항제1호다목 중 “「환경부 및 기상청 소관 비영리법인의 설립과 감독에 관한 규칙」”을 “「기후에너지환경부 및 기상청 소관 비영리법인의 설립과 감독에 관한 규칙」”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 18, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1, Item (c), “「Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Non-Profit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Environment and the Korea Meteorological Administration」” shall be changed to “「Rules on the Establishment and Supervision of Non-Profit Corporations under the Jurisdiction of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Korea Meteorological Administration」”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제7호서식 및 별지 제8호서식 중 “환경부장관”을 각각 “기후에너지환경부장관”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 7 and No. 8, “Minister of Environment” shall be changed to “Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment”.
